name: 0200-with-mac

fields.43: CA PHE GOC PHO           HO CHI MINH  VN

note: packedHexExcludingMac is hex.EncodeToString of the raw bytes returned by the real internal/iso8583.Pack("0200", fields) (DE 64 genuinely absent from the fields map, so bit 64 is unset and no DE 64 bytes are appended) - decode it back to bytes before use. expectedMacHex is ISO 9797-1 algorithm 3 (Retail MAC / X9.19) over those decoded bytes under zakHex (K1 = first 8 bytes, K2 = last 8 bytes): CBC-encrypt zero-padded blocks under K1 with zero IV, decrypt the final block under K2, re-encrypt under K1 - computed with Go's crypto/des per docs/03-iso8583-interface-spec.md section 11. DE 64 in fields above is expectedMacHex uppercased, per Ruling 2 of docs/plans/MCN-502.md.
